column1: # Chat profanity EVASION corpus (QA-owned). Used by ChatFilterCorpusQaTest (core) and ChatModerationQaTest (server).
# expect: MASK   = the cleaned text must differ from the input AND no skeleton of the cleaned text may contain the skeleton of
#                  any listed term (QaTextOracle.skeletons: NFKC, case fold, accents/zero-width removed, look-alikes folded,
#                  leet folded or digits dropped, repeated letters collapsed). Partial masking that destroys the word is fine.
#         CLEAN  = the cleaned text must equal the input exactly (code point for code point).
#         EITHER = product has not decided; only the universal chat invariants are checked (QaTextOracle.chatViolations).
# term:  canonical bad word(s) the row targets, '|' separated. For CLEAN rows: the innocent trap substring (informational).
# Spec: docs/protocol.md section 9.1 (masking also when spaced out, stretched, zero-width, full-width, look-alike letters).
# Rule for spacing: only SINGLE characters separated by spaces/punctuation are an evasion ("f u c k"). Multi-letter
# fragments ("push it", "fu ck") are not joined; see chat_false_positives.tsv for why.
# Format: UTF-8, tab-separated, '#' starts a comment line, first non-comment line is the header.
# Escapes in text columns (decoded by the QA loaders, QaCorpus.kt):
#   \R[N:TEXT] repeats TEXT N times (inside TEXT write \] for ']').
# Invisible, control, bidi and confusable characters are ALWAYS written as escapes so a reviewer can see them;
# QaCorporaWellFormedTest fails if a raw invisible/control/bidi character appears in this file.
